tenderSchedule.description: Primary Collection and Secondary Transportation of Municipal solid waste (MSW) and Street sweeping waste in Gandhinagara division (Package-P7)

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All the Terms and Conditions are as per the RFP Documents Uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: In last 5 financial years (FY 2019-20, 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23 & 2023-24) the Bidder should have achieved in at least two (2) financial years minimum Annual Turnover of Rs.3193.20 Lakhs (two times annual estimated value of the package) 10% weightage would be given per annum to bring the turnover to the present financial year.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have executed similar nature of works for Rs 798.30 Lakhs (50 percent of annual estimated value of the respective package Refer Annexure Chart-1) in any one financial year in last 5 financial years (FY 2019-20, 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23 and 2023-24) In this regard Performance certificate issued from Head of the ULB or the officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer shall be uploaded as proof of evidence for the same. 10% weightage would be given per annum to bring the turnover to the present financial year

Bidder should submit Valid ESI & EPF Certificate, Labour Certificate and copy of Challans of ESI and PF return of any one year in last 5 financial years (FY 2019-20, 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23 & 2023-24)

Bidder should have executed the following quantities in Municipal Solid Waste Management Works Services (either individually or together) as given below in any one year in the last 5 years. Refer Annexure Chart-4 1. Auto tippers (3 wheeler/4wheeler)-138 nos. (80% of the required no. of vehicles) 2. Compactor of not less than 14 cum capacity-8 nos (80% of the required no. of vehicles)

Unconditional Bankers Certificate/ Credit Lines Letter of credit from any Nationalized/ Scheduled Bank for Rs. 478.98 Lakh for each package (30% of annual estimated value of the respective package Refer Annexure Chart-1)

itemList.itemName: Usage Charges of Compactor 16GVW Vehicle of Capacity 14 cum 7.5 Tonnes minimum Loading Rear Chassis Equipped with tipping facility through hydraulic arrangement along Driver and helper

Usage charges of Four wheeler vehicle of 5 Cum Capacity with separate compartments to collect Wet, Dry and Sanitary waste in segregated manner along with Driver & Helper
UUsage charges of Four wheeler vehicle of 2 Cum Capacity with separate compartments to collect Wet, Dry and Sanitary waste in segregated manner along with Driver & Helper
